The Author

About Subhajit

I'm Subhajit Sarkar — a self-taught Python developer, AI builder, aspiring pen tester, and published author from Goalpara, Assam, India, where the Brahmaputra speaks in metaphors and the tea gardens carry stories older than memory.

I build AI-powered SaaS tools, full-stack web applications, and intelligent systems — integrating Grok AI, Google Gemini, and computer vision into real-world products. My stack centres on Python, Flask, and AI APIs — but my heart has always belonged to the written word.

My debut, The Boy, The Bird, and The Sky, began as a quiet story about loss and letting go. It became a saga about power, purpose, and becoming — and it's still unfolding. Parts I, II, III, and IV are all available now.

I write for the people who feel too much. The ones who heard something speaking at 2am that no one else could hear. This story is for you.

— Subhajit
